basis: renders role="separator" with aria-orientation following the orientation prop and aria-valuenow/min/max on the drag- and keyboard-resizable handle between the two panels.

harness.because: pins the separator's aria-valuenow/min/max as the gestures drive it — the value the role reports under real keydowns and pointer drag

interaction.basis: a focusable separator whose arrows, Home/End, pointer drag and double-click resize one panel — Loom's own keydown and pointer handlers, not a wrapped primitive.
